## Description

Finds the Python packages the deposit's code imports. When the deposit has no `.py` or `.ipynb` files, it removes any old outputs and exits.

1. Installs the scanner requirements from `tools/requirements-scanner.txt`.
2. Runs `pipreqs --scan-notebooks`, writing `generated/requirements-generated.txt` (an author's own `requirements.txt` is never touched) and `generated/python-scanner.log`.
3. Runs `tools/filter_requirements.py` to compare the scan with the author's `requirements.txt`, writing `generated/python-deps.csv` and `.md`, and the report note `generated/software-warnings-python.md`.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/15_run_python_scanner.sh <projectID>
```

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
- `ProcessPython` - When `no`, the script exits immediately.
- `pythonbin` - Python command to use (default: `python3`).
